## Actual and expected behavior

Describe the trigger, observed behavior, and intended behavior.

## Reproduction

Provide minimal steps or a synthetic replay. Include versions and the installation/performance profile where relevant. Do not attach private recordings or credentials.

## Evidence and impact

State what was verified, affected scenarios, and what remains uncertain.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Reproduction demonstrates the correction.
- [ ] Relevant regression scenarios are covered.
- [ ] Owning documentation and change report are updated.
